whyThisFile: Moon Trek had no direct elevation subset. This PGDA product is the LOLA 80 m/pixel south-polar GeoTIFF named in DESIGN.md. It covers 80 S to the pole and includes Shackleton. The 181 MB file stays out of git; README has the curl command.

tiepoint.note: Pixel (0, 0) is the north-west corner. x increases east. y decreases south. The grid spans x and y from -304000 m to 304000 m, which is 80 S to the pole.

elevation.note: GDAL history records gmt grdmath multiplying the source grid by 1000, so the stored heights are metres. The source grid's x/y range metadata is still in kilometres; the GeoTIFF tiepoint and pixel scale are metres.

frame: Moon Mean Earth, sphere radius 1737400 m. Product page cites JPL DE421.
